stance_rationale: Sigma is materially improved and passes PSD/condition checks, but the package still finalizes around unclosed RF-R4/CVaR, RF-R3 TDC, factor-coverage, RF-R7 decay, and schedule-artifact gaps. These are not fatal covariance bugs, but they are decision-grade gaps that require explicit revision before an optimizer/governor handoff can be treated as complete.

regime_sigma_audit.comment: PIT expanding t-1 labels and bootstrap monitoring are now present, but 64.38% switch rate is too unstable to become an optimizer trading signal without an explicit turnover/control layer.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: alpha_scores.parquet remains one as_of_date snapshot; alpha_ic_panel_walkforward exists for IC validation, but requested weights.csv and optimization_package are absent, so schedule-level risk validation cannot be completed.

critical_concerns.description: RF-R4 and CVaR breaches remain unresolved as handoff blockers: CVaR95 loss magnitude is 11.92% versus 2.5% cap and GFC loss is 34.33% versus the 25% RF-R4 threshold. Disclosure is improved, but finalization relies on 'optimizer overlay scope' rather than a concrete risk-budget constraint or infeasibility gate.

Crowding cannot be cleared because TDC vs PG2 is not computed and active correlation is substituted. Severe HHI flags remain for Q04, M05, and M01, so family saturation and tail co-movement are not closed.

Mean per-name factor coverage R2 is 0.196, below the 30% checklist floor. The package admits this but still calls it acceptable, and evaluation text still says '100% LW/RMT shrinkage applied' even though actual LW shrinkage is 0.4787 and RMT was not selected.

Requested cross-agent verification is incomplete: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260614_002 and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260614_002 do not exist, weights.csv and optimization_package.json are absent, and tail_risk.json is absent. The actual artifacts are under stage_artifacts/WT-D20260614_002, so AX-008 path and schedule triangulation fail for this target.
RF-R7 is not explicitly tested. The package notes recent-regime decay and alpha oos_retention=-0.52, but it does not compute a SubStab decay ratio or compare it to the >3x RF-R7 threshold.

Regime diagnostics are PIT-safe after remediation, but the estimated switch rate is 64.38% versus the prompt's <30% management target. Labeling it 'diagnostic only' is acceptable only if optimizer inputs explicitly exclude direct regime switching from this artifact.

The prior stress_policy_ok || TRUE override is removed, and stress_audit now honestly reports stress_8_pass=false and CVaR breach.

unresolved_disputes: Whether a risk package may finalize with RF-R4/CVaR breaches if it labels mitigation as optimizer/forge scope.
Whether monthly active correlation is an acceptable temporary substitute for TDC vs PG2; the role prompt asks for TDC.
Whether factor coverage below 30% can be accepted based on portfolio-level factor share rather than per-name R2.
Whether schedule artifacts are out of risk scope or mandatory for this requested critique target; either way, weights.csv is absent.
Whether static as-of B/D is sufficient for a one-date forecast when the critique request explicitly asks for schedule validation.
weakest_assumption: That honest disclosure plus role-boundary deferral is enough to finalize risk even though RF-R4/CVaR, TDC vs PG2, factor R2 floor, RF-R7 decay, and schedule artifacts remain unclosed.
rebuttal_required: Provide a concrete optimizer-facing risk-budget constraint or infeasibility gate for CVaR95 and RF-R4 breaches, not only a narrative overlay handoff.
Compute TDC vs PG2 active book or issue a formal data-unavailability report that keeps RF-R3 open.
Correct the factor_coverage_justification text and explain why R2=0.196 is acceptable despite the 30% floor without implying 100% shrinkage.
Add RF-R7 SubStab decay computation or explicitly mark RF-R7 unresolved.
Clarify path lineage: actual stage_artifacts/WT-D20260614_002 versus requested missing A/B paths, and state whether weights.csv/optimization_package are intentionally deferred.
State explicitly that regime labels are diagnostic-only and not optimizer switching signals unless a turnover-control layer is added.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Claude fixed the largest covariance defects, but over-closes the package by converting still-open red flags into scope deferrals. Sigma can be used as a diagnostic input, but the risk handoff is not complete enough for clean optimizer/governor reliance.

What exact TDC definition versus PG2 active book will be used, and why is active correlation sufficient before that is computed?
Why should per-name factor R2=0.196 pass the 30% checklist floor, and why does the package still mention 100% LW/RMT shrinkage?
Is RF-R7 intentionally out of scope, or should recent-regime decay and oos_retention=-0.52 trigger a SubStab decay test?
Are weights.csv and optimization_package absent because optimizer has not run, or because this WT is only a one-date risk forecast?
